issue.body: Checkpoint metadata and diffs existed behind internal services, but coding agents could not discover or inspect a durable restore target through MCP. This adds bounded `t3_checkpoint_list` and `t3_checkpoint_diff` tools scoped to the caller's current project. Results expose stable scope/source identity, per-checkpoint availability and restore support, bounded file summaries, and UTF-16-safe diff cursors without duplicating checkpoint storage. Behavior: - validates thread, scope, checkpoint, and filesystem ref identity before reading diffs - slices checkpoint pages before availability I/O and isolates unreadable entries - exposes read tools consistently through the MCP server, provider allowlists, presentation, and user/internal docs - marks ambiguous materialized baselines and null-ordinal targets unsupported instead of mapping them to thread start Focused validation: - checkpoint contract and service tests - production MCP `tools/list` root-object schema coverage - presentation and Claude read-only allowlist coverage - targeted contracts/server/shared typecheck, lint, and formatting Dependency: bottom layer of native stack #8713, rooted on `agents/mcp-controls/base-490318a` at the agreed V2 pin. Implemented by GPT-5.6-Sol via Codex in T3 Code. > [!NOTE] > ### Add `t3_checkpoint_list` and `t3_checkpoint_diff` MCP tools for inspecting durable checkpoints > - Introduces `CheckpointMcpService` exposing list and diff operations that accept an MCP invocation scope and return typed checkpoint results or failures > - `t3_checkpoint_list` returns newest-first paginated checkpoint metadata with bounded file summaries, per-entry availability status, and restore-support blockers; reads are restricted to the caller's project > - `t3_checkpoint_diff` reads only ready checkpoints in the requested scope, requests complete VCS output, and returns UTF-16-safe paginated patch pages that never split surrogate pairs > - Adds validated contract schemas in [checkpointMcp.ts](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/8702/files#diff-946ae3200c662e833e6cde6ba189cfa3584f0f25c5709c8df9900998ea0f65f0) for inputs, results, availability states, restore blockers, and failure codes; re-exports from the contracts barrel > - Registers the checkpoint toolkit in [McpHttpServer.ts](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/8702/files#diff-d5ed4053027686ef86dbdd41eb8a839268f0c99d955c7f22f62516a976c4d2b8) and pre-approves both tools in Claude's read-only allowlist in [ClaudeAdapterV2.ts](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/8702/files#diff-688f35750a1a36e66ae76758c856df3d4f0115f93627eb17b390b3abb76afef4) > - Adds `checkpointRollbackAppRunOrdinal` helper in [orchestrationV2.ts](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/8702/files#diff-b32ccdacc28721bf0de57f1d053cd6e766d7d6119475e59292cb21d9f30ba984) that returns null for ambiguous later or manual checkpoint metadata, so callers cannot infer thread-start rollback from a null app ordinal > - Behavioral Change: `GitVcsDriver` checkpoint diff now uses error mode when `requireCompleteOutput` is true, so oversized complete diffs fail with `VcsProcessOutputLimitError` instead of returning truncated stdout; ordinary patch diffs retain truncating mode > > > > Macroscope summarized 3dbdf6f. > > --- > [!NOTE] > **Medium Risk** > New orchestration-scoped MCP reads touch thread projections and checkpoint refs; diff fail-closed behavior and stricter rollback ordinal resolution can change how agents interpret restore eligibility versus prior implicit zero mapping. > > **Overview** > Adds read-only **`t3_checkpoint_list`** and **`t3_checkpoint_diff`** MCP tools so agents can discover checkpoint metadata and bounded patches within the caller’s project, wired through **`CheckpointMcpService`**, contracts, HTTP toolkit registration, Claude read-only allowlists, and user/docs. > > **List** loads durable V2 projections (newest first, offset pagination), checks filesystem refs only for the returned page, caps file summaries per checkpoint, and returns availability plus **restore-support blockers** (thread state, provider capabilities, ref health). Unreadable refs mark a single entry without failing the page. > > **Diff** validates thread, scope, checkpoint, and ref identity before returning patches; it requests **`requireCompleteOutput: true`** from **`CheckpointStore`** / Git so oversized diffs **fail closed** (`VcsProcessOutputLimitError`) instead of silent truncation, then paginates in-memory with **UTF-16-safe** cursors. > > Shared **`checkpointRollbackAppRunOrdinal`** tightens rollback targeting: null `appRunOrdinal` resolves to run **0** only for the ordinal-zero **root_run** scope; later materialized baselines and manual scopes surface **`rollback_target_ambiguous`** in MCP restore hints. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 3dbdf6f9b6a961b3bd8ebe836eca328aaa0f8d47. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).
